Noah (AE): Quick sync: Celestia wants a 2-week technical POC. Kickoff Tue 10:00 CET. Primary goals: validate semantic search relevance, p95 latency target ~350ms, and reduce monthly inference cost by ~45%. EU residency required.
Pri (SE): Tue 10 works. Do we have their eval set size and traffic profile?
Noah (AE): They said ~4k labeled queries, steady 18 qps, short bursts to 60 qps. Will confirm exact metric (Precision@5 vs Recall@10).
Lina (Eng): Plan: start hosted for fast baseline, run Dedicated for final comparison. Infra needs: trial project in EU, model pin to rwd-embed-v2, prefix caching, and autoscale policy for bursts. Estimate 1xA10G baseline.
Marco (Security): I'll need SSQ v3, a data flow diagram, and confirmation of no PHI. KMS/SSO questions likely; send IdP metadata if they require SAML. DPA required before Dedicated.
Zoe (CS): I'll own invites and the demo sandbox. Pricing ask: committed vs burst options — I'll prepare a short delta table.
Pri (SE): Ops checklist I'll add: create project, scoped API key, pin model, set request quotas, enable traces. Example CLI: `redwood projects create --name celestia-poc --region eu`.
Noah (AE): Proposed kickoff agenda (30m): 1) intros (5m) 2) success criteria & eval metric (10m) 3) data/security checklist (5m) 4) timeline & owners (5m) 5) blockers (5m).
Lina (Eng): Concrete success criteria we should capture: a) p95 <= 350ms at 18 qps b) Precision@5 >= 0.72 (or equivalent) on their eval c) end-to-end cost per 10k queries <= target we'll compute.
Marco (Security): Blockers: DPA timing, SSO metadata, and completed SSQ. On-prem evaluation would add 6-8 weeks.
Zoe (CS): Action items: Zoe 1 pricing delta + invite roster (due EOD today). Noah 1 confirm metric choice & request dataset (due Mon). Pri 1 infra runbook + demo sandbox (due Tue AM). Marco 1 SSQ kickoff & artifact list (due Mon).
gcal-bot: Meeting created: "Celestia POC Kickoff" Tue 10:00 CET, 30m. Invites sent.
Noah (AE): Thanks team 1 I'll post shared drive link and client answers after the call. :rocket:
